title: Busywork check
desc: Once a day, speaks up when small tasks take over a big part of your workday

variables.name: budget_share
variables.desc: the share of your time at the computer small tasks may take, 0 to 1

variables.name: budget_day
variables.desc: the day it last spoke up

signals.name: shallow_share
signals.desc: the share of today's time at the computer that was shallow (the day clock counts both)

next.desc: a workday, an hour in, over the share, not said today

context.format: Small tasks have taken {share:.0%} of your time today. Want to park the rest for later and do one stretch of real work?

do.name: nudged
do.desc: quiet for a while now, longer if it went unanswered

set.name: nudged_at
set.expr: time + (nudge_gap if answer is None else 0)
